verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure intact: logo pill, shoe sitting on the panel, centred eyebrow/headline/subcopy/CTA stack, and the confetti frame. It is mostly a proportional shrink, and there is slightly loose dead space under the CTA inside the panel, but nothing is broken. B is broken in several ways. The panel swallows almost all the confetti and bleeds off the right edge. 'DROP 07' falls below the subcopy, which breaks reading order, and the subcopy leaves 'gone.' orphaned on its own line. The CTA and the VOLTSTRIDE logo shrink to tiny, left-aligned items jammed at the bottom, and a large dead gap sits between the shoe and the CTA.
